data.title: Nvidia Yet to Hire Search Firm for Jensen Huang's Successor as Arm CEO Rene Haas Reportedly Emerges as Potential Contender
data.description: Nvidia has yet to begin its CEO search, with Arm's Rene Haas emerging as a potential successor to Jensen Huang.

data.title: Trump to Push Putin, Xi On Nuclear Weapons Cuts In Unprecedented Meeting, But White House Does Not Expect A Deal: 'Difficult Topic for China'
data.description: Donald Trump will push Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping on nuclear arms reductions, though the White House expects no deal.

data.title: Elon Musk's Starship Fails to Nail Booster Catch In Ambitious Flight 15 Test for SpaceX, But Upper Stage Reaches Orbit
data.description: SpaceX's Starship Flight 15 missed its booster catch attempt, while the upper stage continued toward orbit carrying Starlink satellites.

data.title: Elon Musk Says He Is ‘Signing’ Petition to Reinstate Jensen Huang as Nvidia Employees Rally Behind Former CEO
data.description: On Friday, Elon Musk said he had joined calls to reinstate former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang following his resignation.

data.title: ChatGPT Wallet Lets OpenAI's Dots AI Agents Shop On Your Behalf Without Accessing Actual Card Details
data.description: OpenAI unveiled ChatGPT Wallet, a new payment capability that allows its “dots” AI agents to complete purchases for users' behalf.
